prior_persistence_failure: GitHub Actions token refused creation/update of a workflow-containing evidence branch because the runner checkout was based on an older main commit. The result files existed and validated locally but were not pushed before runner teardown.
rerun_policy: Execute the byte-identical authoritative v1.0.3 data audit again solely because the validated result bytes were lost after a persistence-layer push rejection. Do not reuse the prior counts as current result data and do not alter any selection, T0, horizon, staleness, history class, semantic or denominator rule.
persistence_repair: Before committing result files, copy them outside the worktree, reset/checkout the evidence branch from the latest origin/main, restore only the three result files, and push a branch whose only diff from current main is those result files.
governance: The prior PASS is retained as audit evidence, but downstream stages remain blocked until a newly executed byte-identical v1.0.3 result is persisted and independently revalidates the same frozen gates.
